description:
Sara, the daughter of a gang boss, was born and raised in the shadows. Burdened by an inferiority complex over her background, she has spent her life alone, shut away behind a barrier built partly by choice and partly by circumstance. Instead of dreaming of an ordinary, loving family, she chooses a far more dangerous alternative. Kidnap Woo Seungha, the actor who perfectly matches her ideal type, have his child, and make that child her family for life. When Seungha hears Sara’s provocative plan, his expression hardens as he bluntly tells her that what she is proposing is a crime. Sara immediately corrects him. “All I want is a child. Once my wish comes true, I’ll disappear from your life forever and live up to my name. I swear.”
